I’m Michael. I recently graduated with a Masters of Science in Civic Analytics from UIC. I am passionate about civic technology projects and urbanism. I live in Avondale with my wife Becky and cat Malbec.
During my masters program, we often produced data projects using RMarkdown or Quarto. With my newly attained free time, I hope to continue developing my data analysis skills in this blog format.

title: Making a Cartogram in Quarto
text:
In my previous post, I used a cartogram as my visualization.
This post is a technical walkthrough of challenges and final implementation for a cartogram in Quarto.
poverty_cd_s1701 <- get_acs(geography = "congressional district", 
        table = 'S1701',
        year = 2023,
        geometry = TRUE,
        cache_table = TRUE)

poverty_cd_s1701 %>% 
  glimpse()

v2023 <- load_variables(2023, "acs5/subject", cache = TRUE)

v2023 %>% glimpse()

v2023 %>% 
  filter(name == 'S1701_C01_001') %>% 
  glimpse()

data("fips_codes")

states <- fips_codes %>% 
  select(state, state_code) %>% 
  distinct()

poverty_cd_s1701_labels <- poverty_cd_s1701 %>% 
  left_join(v2023,
            by = c("variable" = "name")) %>% 
  mutate(state_code = substr(GEOID, 1, 2)) %>% 
  left_join(states)

poverty_cd_s1701_labels %>% 
  glimpse()
